svg.title: Athrya — platform architecture (sanitized)
svg.desc: Athrya architecture, sanitized: five client surfaces (mobile app, portal, platform admin and invite landing in production; dashboard in development) depend on shared packages holding the domain, use cases and contracts; a single API is the authorization authority with tenant scope enforced in the data layer; managed PostgreSQL in a private network with 233 additive migrations applied only by a migration pipeline; delivery through one mandatory PR gate, image build, migrations, staged deploy, smoke and promote or rollback.
